scope: Ninja Kage conversion in OpenJKDF2 MotS mode; native multiplayer character allocation, disk save and fresh-process reload.
capture_method: Unretouched 1280x960 OpenGL framebuffer PNGs after native menu painting and swaps in a hidden, unfocused game window. No desktop capture.
input_method: Finite native UI callbacks and native character-save/reload functions; no direct rank or power grants.

disk_save.note: Native multiplayer exit discards unspent allocation stars; the saved spend field is zero. This is not campaign progression evidence.

visual_inspection: Inspected available, allocated and Defense-restricted GL views and both pairs of native icon crops. Added icons are distinct when disabled and do not overlap neighboring controls.
limitations: Mouse-hover hints and physical mouse/keyboard operation were not exercised.
These menu tests do not establish Force combat effects, respawn, campaign saves, other personalities or full mod compatibility.
The test uses the Ninja conversion; it does not establish gameplay compatibility of the separate stock-MotS Force add-on.

images.caption: Native rank-five Jedi allocation: Throw and Lightning are available.
Native Defense restrictions disable both added powers; their icons use distinct dark states.
Three points allocated to each restored power; nine of the original fifteen stars remain before leaving the screen.
